contracts.declared_mechanism: Thresholds registered as CLI arguments (--min-score, --max-critical, --max-failed, --min-metric, --min-resistance) and evaluated exhaustively by evaluate_gates (every gate checked, no short-circuit); main() reduces gate results with all() to select EXIT_OK vs EXIT_GATE_FAILED; a pre-flight /health check ('database' != 'connected') and any evaluation exception force EXIT_ERROR before a pass is possible; inconclusive (no resistanceScore) or non-gateable (sourceAuthorityOnlyTools) ladders append explicit failing gate results instead of inventing a pass or defaulting to 0.0.
contracts.forbidden_condition: The CI process exiting 0 (EXIT_OK, 'PASSED') while any registered gate fails — score below --min-score, critical failures above --max-critical, failed scenarios above --max-failed, a --min-metric floor unmet, or guardrail resistance below --min-resistance — or exiting 0 / passing when the evaluator reports database not 'connected', when run_evaluation raises (including the evaluation timeout), or when the guardrail ladder yields no resistanceScore (inconclusive) or only sourceAuthorityOnlyTools (non-gateable) while --min-resistance is set.

contracts.protection_obligation: The CI gate command `python -m app.ci` must terminate with a non-zero process exit code — EXIT_GATE_FAILED (1) when any registered quality gate fails, EXIT_ERROR (2) when the run cannot complete — unless the evaluated agent clears every configured threshold (reliability score >= --min-score, critical failures <= --max-critical, failed scenarios <= --max-failed, any --min-metric floors, and guardrail resistance >= --min-resistance when configured), and it must fail closed (EXIT_ERROR or a failed gate, never a pass) when the evaluator database is unhealthy, when the evaluation raises or times out, or when the resistance ladder is inconclusive or non-gateable.
